# Davy Keith

## Overview

- **Age:** Seven years old when arriving at Green Gables  <sub>[v2 c22 P1](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c19 P47](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0047), [v2 c22 P18](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0018)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Davy-boy  <sub>[v3 c22 P23](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0023)</sub>; Mr. Davy Keith  <sub>[v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Davy is a fair-complexioned boy with a crop of fuzzy yellow ringlets all over his round head. He has roguish, dancing hazel eyes, a snub nose, and a smile with a dimple in only one cheek, giving him a comical, lopsided look when he laughs. At one point, he loses a front tooth and grows bare, brown heels from running outdoors.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c19 P44](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0044)_

## Personality

Davy is an energetic, highly inquisitive, and mischievous boy who frequently gets into minor scrapes. Though blunt and occasionally stubborn about rules, he is sweet-natured, affectionate, and deeply attached to Anne Shirley. He possesses an endless curiosity about the world and constantly asks questions.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c19 P41](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0041), [v2 c19 P45](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0045), [v3 c22 P26](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0026)_

- To marry Stella Fletcher when he grows up  <sub>[v3 c22 P35](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0035), [v3 c22 P37](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0037)</sub>

## History

Davy Keith and his twin sister Dora were orphaned and eventually brought to Green Gables to live with Marilla Cuthbert and Anne Shirley. Upon his arrival, Davy immediately showed a lively, unruly disposition, often testing Marilla's patience with his candid remarks and table manners. Unlike his quiet sister, Davy bonded warmly with Anne, who guided his behavior with gentleness and imagination. Following the death of his uncle, Richard Keith, a trust fund was established to cover Davy and Dora's living expenses, allowing them to remain permanently at Green Gables. Davy attended Avonlea School, where he engaged in outdoor adventures with classmates like Milty Boulter and developed an innocent childhood crush on Stella Fletcher.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 c8 P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c19 P44](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0044), [v2 c22 P20](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0020), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 c22 P25](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0025), [v3 c22 P20](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0020), [v3 c22 P39](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0039)_
